question: Estimate the call volume on a typical Indian fintech IVR during salary day (last working day of month).
idealClarificationQuestions: Major fintech (e.g., PhonePe / GPay / Paytm) with 250M MAU? Yes.
Salary day = month-end peak with rent, transfer, EMI rush? Yes.
Voice calls into IVR + agent? Yes.
Peak hour or full-day volume? Both — flag peak hour.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average daily support contact rate × salary-day uplift × voice channel share.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average daily support contacts (calculated in Q78): ~100K.
